description: This PHP source file defines the ElasticSearchEngine class, a search engine implementation that uses Elasticsearch for near real-time search within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for constructing search parameters, executing searches, and parsing results, and references external Elasticsearch client and SuiteCRM classes.

classes.name: ElasticSearchEngine
classes.description: A search engine class that interfaces with Elasticsearch to perform search queries and parse results within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Elasticsearch client, optionally accepting a custom client.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search using the provided SearchQuery, returning SearchResults with timing and hit count.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates and preprocesses the SearchQuery object.

methods.name: createSearchParams
methods.description: Generates Elasticsearch API parameters from a SearchQuery, including wildcard handling.

methods.name: runElasticSearch
methods.description: Executes the search request to Elasticsearch with given parameters.

methods.name: parseHits
methods.description: Parses Elasticsearch hits into a structured array grouped by module, including fetching module metadata.
